motionNotes: The row's own framing is machine-first ('the functions a lending system calls') but the BUYER is the operator/developer who owns the lender's integration surface — B2D. Wave-zero mounted shapes: the keyless anon sandbox (universal floor) and the 402-metered boundary as a labeled test-mode stub. The B2D OAuth free tier and checkout are NOT yet mounted and therefore NOT advertised (mounted-rungs-only ruling); they are recorded here as the next rungs to mount. B2A callers are pointed at apis.ax; no OAuth/CC gate is imposed on machine identities here.

counterpartBrand.note: ICP is operators/developers at licensed institutions — technical principals; no B2A2B/C leg at wave zero. The §9.3 agent-referred-human diagnostic is armed via the signal seam; a counterpart-brand proposal files against the register row if it trips.

positioning: The functions a lending system calls — the data and functions layer of banking, lending & payments, never the payment rails (rails are avoid-class 3 by register ruling). (The 'agent default' claim is WITHHELD: the §4.6 worthiness bar — hosted conformance verdict + live anon sandbox + continuously verified published suite — has not been attested by api.qa yet.)
mdxNotes: Custom minimal HTML landing at wave zero (§7.1 prove-then-extract); per-brand MDX layer deferred to the shared-renderer extraction.

experiment.hypothesis: Per-call metering with per-outcome rows on the two regulated doors (credit-file pull, origination submission) converts lending-system developers from sandbox to metered better than flat tiers; the door operations, not record reads, carry the revenue.

platformConsumption.payments.do: consumed, not contained (Batch-S) — blocks the monetized-serving stage only, never the face; every payable door is a labeled 402-shaped stub until it lands
